pairs.subject: scoring-rubrics
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:124 feeds signal.successRate into the heaviest (0.30) dimension ignoring successRateSource, which src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:415 sets to 100 for an unmeasured persona, so an idle agent collects full marks and can take a medal; re-confirmed 2026-10-16, 6 of 7 techniques deviate, code unchanged since the 2026-10-12 verdict

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:124 success always enters the composite; unknown source is 100 (src/stores/slices/overview/personaHealthSlice.ts:415) and proxy is the fleet rate, never excluded, no coverage floor, nothing in sub_leaderboard reads successRateSource
src/features/overview/sub_leaderboard/libs/leaderboardScoring.ts:58 vector sums to 1 but carries no per-weight rationale and no version, so a weight change silently re-ranks
